title: Magus Drive
summary: Magus Drive is an Arcane Enhancement for the Operator that increases K-Drive speed for 30 seconds upon performing Transference back into the player's Warframe.
extract:
Magus Drive is an Arcane Enhancement for the Operator that increases K-Drive speed for 30 seconds upon performing Transference back into the player's Warframe.

Effect

Acquisition
Can be bought from Vox Solaris (Syndicate) for  10,000 upon reaching the rank of Instrument.

Notes
Does not work with  Yareli's  Merulina.
Does not work with the Bondi K-Drive.
